_note: What 'Write the copy' runs, per kind of month. The planner plans; something else writes. A pattern matching the run folder's name wins, else `default`. {run} = the run folder, {run_name} = its bare name, {slots} = the comma-joined slot ids the reviewer picked. `cwd` is relative to the WORKSPACE ROOT (not to this file), so moving this tool between lab/ and components/ never breaks the hand-off.
